project.title: Standardised Accounting and Move-Cost Tracking for Relocation Jobs
project.objective: Design and roll out a unified accounting and cost-tracking process for all relocation jobs, including dangerous goods moves, to improve accuracy and compliance.
deliverables: Documented chart of accounts tailored to relocation activities
Standard operating procedure for recording move-related transactions
Template set for job costing and profitability analysis
Monthly financial statements format aligned with new structure
Training session and quick-reference guide for bookkeepers
constraints: Go-live for new process within 21 days
Must comply with statutory obligations and company policies
No changes to core accounting system, only configuration and procedures
Historical data restatement limited to current fiscal year
Solution must support dangerous goods moves tracking
Minimal disruption to ongoing invoicing and payments

risks.risk: Incorrect mapping of relocation activities to new chart of accounts.
risks.mitigation: Pilot with a small set of jobs and review with finance manager before full rollout.

risks.risk: Non-compliance with statutory obligations for dangerous goods cost tracking.
risks.mitigation: Review procedures with health and safety officer and external auditor prior to sign-off.

risks.risk: Bookkeepers inconsistently applying the new procedures.
risks.mitigation: Provide training, quick-reference guides, and a short post-go-live review cycle.

risks.risk: Delays due to dependency on operations data for job costing.
risks.mitigation: Define minimum data set and interim manual capture process with relocation coordinators.

themes.why_relevant: Needed to reflect relocation-specific revenue, costs, and dangerous goods handling fees.
Processes must meet statutory obligations and withstand external audits.
Management wants visibility into profitability per move and service type.
Current booking and posting practices vary by person and cause errors.
Accurate reconciliations reduce accounting errors and rework.
All bookkeepers must adopt the new process consistently and quickly.

backlog.task: Draft relocation-focused chart of accounts structure
definition_of_done: New accounts for relocation revenue, direct costs, and surcharges defined
Account descriptions and usage rules documented
Reviewed and approved by finance manager

backlog.task: Design standard operating procedure for recording relocation jobs
definition_of_done: End-to-end posting flow from job creation to invoice documented
Dangerous goods handling and surcharges steps included
Reviewed with operations manager and health and safety officer

backlog.task: Create job costing template for each relocation job
definition_of_done: Template captures revenue, labour, transport, and dangerous goods costs
Fields align with chart of accounts
Tested on at least three recent jobs

backlog.task: Define monthly reconciliation checklist for relocation accounts
definition_of_done: Checklist covers bank, revenue, cost, and suspense accounts
Frequency and responsible roles defined
Validated by finance manager

backlog.task: Configure accounting system categories to match new chart of accounts
definition_of_done: No structural system changes, only categories and mappings updated
Sample postings confirm correct account usage
Rollback plan documented

backlog.task: Prepare sample monthly financial statements using new structure
definition_of_done: Profit and loss and balance sheet generated for pilot month
Relocation segment clearly visible
Differences vs old format explained in notes

backlog.task: Document compliance checks for dangerous goods cost handling
definition_of_done: List of statutory obligations impacting accounting prepared
Controls and evidence required for each obligation defined
Reviewed with health and safety officer
One-page summary of key posting rules created
Common error scenarios and corrections listed
Shared in channel and acknowledged by all bookkeepers

backlog.task: Run training session on new accounting procedures
definition_of_done: Agenda and materials prepared
All bookkeepers attend or review recording
Open questions captured and resolved

backlog.task: Pilot new process on a limited set of relocation jobs
definition_of_done: At least five jobs processed with new templates and SOP
Issues logged and prioritised
Go/no-go recommendation documented

backlog.task: Align with external auditor on documentation expectations
definition_of_done: Key audit evidence for relocation accounts listed
Sample documentation pack prepared
Auditor feedback incorporated into SOP

backlog.task: Define handover process between movers/operations and accounting
definition_of_done: Minimum data set from operations agreed
Cut-off times for daily job data handover defined
Process documented in SOP and shared with relocation coordinators

threads_plan.thread_goal: Align on scope and approve target chart of accounts for relocation jobs.
threads_plan.trigger: Kickoff message announcing project and sharing first draft of A1.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Approve or revise the proposed relocation chart of accounts in A1.
Confirm which relocation activities require separate tracking lines.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Define and finalise the relocation accounting SOP, including handover.
threads_plan.trigger: Share first full draft of A2 and request comments from all bookkeepers.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Agree on the end-to-end posting flow for relocation jobs in A2.
Confirm minimum data set required from operations for each job.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Design and validate the job costing template and reconciliation checklist.
threads_plan.trigger: Post initial versions of A3 and A4 for review and test feedback.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Approve the structure and fields of the job costing template A3.
Agree on the monthly reconciliation steps in A4.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Plan and debrief the pilot of the new process on selected jobs.
threads_plan.trigger: Announcement that pilot (T10) is starting and link to A7 issue log.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Decide go/no-go for full rollout after reviewing pilot results.
Prioritise which pilot issues must be fixed before rollout.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Prepare training, quick-reference materials, and audit evidence pack.
threads_plan.trigger: Share draft A6 and A8 and propose training session schedule.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Sign off on A6 quick-reference guide content and format.
Agree on final list of documents included in audit evidence pack A8.

channel_rituals: Daily async check-in on progress against top three tasks
Twice-weekly review of open issues in the pilot issue log
Weekly summary post with decisions made and documents updated
Pre-deadline readiness check to confirm go-live status
Post-rollout retrospective on what to improve in the new process
